entities.name: Glimmervoid
entities.description: An expanse of low hills of smooth, tiled metal on Mirrodin, functionally the plane's desert.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane where the Glimmervoid lies.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: A region of Mirrodin reached by crossing the Glimmervoid.

entities.name: Ur-golems
entities.description: A nearly forgotten race of powerful artifact creatures whose runes are on the Glimmervoid towers.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: A being the Glimmervoid towers warn about.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders whose takeover made the Glimmervoid a Contested War Zone.

entities.name: Mirran Resistance
entities.description: Mirran survivors who harvested plates of the former Glimmervoid to make hexgold.

entities.name: Hexgold
entities.description: A substance made from Glimmervoid plates that staved off phyresis.

entities.name: Mirrex
entities.description: The wasteland that the previous surface of Mirrodin became after compleation.

events.summary: During the Phyrexian takeover the Glimmervoid became a Contested War Zone.
events.quote: During the Phyrexian takeover the Glimmervoid became a Contested War Zone .
